commands.name: doctor
commands.effect: read-only diagnostics

commands.name: dev:chain
commands.effect: starts loopback Anvil

commands.name: dev:bootstrap
commands.effect: deploys contracts, registers the deployment, seeds catalog data, and catches up projections
commands.prerequisite: loopback Anvil and a selected owned environment

commands.name: dev:full
commands.effect: starts API, Indexer, and Web
commands.prerequisite: bootstrap complete for the selected environment

commands.name: dev:ui
commands.effect: starts only the Vite Web process
commands.prerequisite: bootstrap complete for the selected environment

commands.name: dev:api
commands.effect: starts only the readonly API process

commands.name: dev:indexer
commands.effect: starts only the normal Indexer writer

commands.name: storybook
commands.effect: starts isolated UI development server

commands.name: generate
commands.effect: updates ABI, OpenAPI, and generated artifacts

commands.name: generate:check
commands.effect: read-only generated artifact drift check

commands.name: check:architecture
commands.effect: checks dependency graph and negative fixtures

commands.name: check
commands.effect: runs format, docs, architecture, typecheck, and lint gates

commands.name: lint
commands.effect: runs ESLint with zero warnings allowed

commands.name: format:check
commands.effect: read-only Prettier conformance check

commands.name: test:unit
commands.effect: runs TypeScript unit, component, database, seed, and recovery suites except integration/E2E

commands.name: test:components
commands.effect: runs React component tests with Vitest and JSDOM

commands.name: test:contracts
commands.effect: runs Foundry unit, fuzz, and invariant tests

commands.name: test:integration
commands.effect: runs SQLite and isolated real-Anvil integration suites
commands.prerequisite: Foundry and workspace dependencies installed; test ports free

commands.name: test:e2e
commands.effect: starts isolated local Anvil and app processes

commands.name: build
commands.effect: builds all workspace packages and applications

commands.name: release:metadata
commands.effect: writes local release-readiness metadata without publishing

commands.name: verify
commands.effect: local generated, docs, architecture, test, and build gate

commands.name: ops:reconcile
commands.effect: writes an anchored chain/projection comparison report

commands.name: ops:audit-source
commands.effect: read-only finalized source comparison against an independently configured secondary RPC
commands.prerequisite: MOTORCOVE_ENV set; independent secondary RPC URL and finalized range; read-only local database

commands.name: ops:rebuild
commands.effect: atomically rebuilds projections from verified local evidence
commands.prerequisite: MOTORCOVE_ENV set; API and Indexer stopped

commands.name: demo:advance-time
commands.effect: advances and mines time on verified loopback Anvil
commands.prerequisite: local Anvil running on chain ID 31337

commands.name: demo:reset
commands.effect: resets loopback Anvil and removes generated state from the selected owned environment
commands.prerequisite: MOTORCOVE_ENV set; stopped services; disposable environment only

commands.name: db:generate
commands.effect: changes migration artifacts and schema contract

commands.name: db:check
commands.effect: temporary DB only

commands.name: db:status
commands.effect: read-only; does not create environment

commands.name: db:plan
commands.effect: read-only migration plan

commands.name: db:migrate
commands.effect: maintenance write; creates owned environment when absent

commands.name: db:verify
commands.effect: coordinated read-only verification

commands.name: db:backup
commands.effect: writes a verified standard snapshot with ready-source and projection evidence
commands.prerequisite: API and Indexer stopped; no incomplete maintenance marker

commands.name: db:restore
commands.effect: destructive maintenance with quarantine; accepts standard ready-source snapshots only
commands.prerequisite: verified STANDARD backup, matching deployment, and stopped services

commands.name: seed:catalog
commands.effect: maintenance write; no chain transaction

commands.name: seed:dev
commands.effect: runs the local bootstrap profile
commands.prerequisite: MOTORCOVE_ENV set; loopback Anvil; owned environment

commands.name: seed:demo
commands.effect: runs the local demo bootstrap profile
commands.prerequisite: MOTORCOVE_ENV set; loopback Anvil; owned environment

commands.name: seed:test
commands.effect: runs the isolated test bootstrap profile
commands.prerequisite: test harness environment and loopback Anvil

commands.name: ops:recover
commands.effect: Inspects markers; completes verified migration/restore recovery and keeps incomplete projection work action-required.

commands.name: ops:reindex
commands.effect: rewinds source evidence, refetches canonical history, and rebuilds projections
commands.prerequisite: MOTORCOVE_ENV set; stopped services; verified loopback deployment

commands.name: test:migrations
commands.effect: runs native migration history and drift tests in temporary SQLite environments

commands.name: test:db
commands.effect: runs database ownership, locking, constraints, and reset-boundary tests

commands.name: test:seeds
commands.effect: runs catalog seed identity and idempotency tests

commands.name: test:recovery
commands.effect: runs backup readiness, restore refusal, and maintenance marker recovery tests

commands.name: docs:generate
commands.effect: updates metadata-owned Markdown regions and the migration-derived database schema reference
commands.prerequisite: documentation metadata, database model, and migration history valid

commands.name: docs:generate:check
commands.effect: read-only generated Markdown, database table-model coverage, and physical schema drift check
commands.prerequisite: documentation metadata, database model, and migration history valid

commands.name: docs:check
commands.effect: read-only docs consistency checks

commands.name: docs:smoke
commands.effect: temporary SQLite test environments only
